nodes.title: Adjustable Breathing Trainer
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Train the muscles you breathe with. This compact breathing trainer adds adjustable resistance to every breath, so you can work on your respiratory strength and endurance at home, at the gym or on the go.

Why you'll like it

  • Adjustable resistance – set the intensity with an easy-to-turn dial and increase it as you progress.
  • Portable and lightweight – small enough to carry in a pocket or gym bag.
  • For every level – suitable for beginners and experienced athletes.
  • No equipment needed – just a few minutes a day, wherever you are.

seo.description: Portable breathing trainer with an adjustable resistance dial. Train your respiratory muscles anywhere, at any fitness level.

nodes.title: Portable Manual Espresso Maker
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Espresso wherever you are. This hand-press coffee maker works without batteries or electricity and brews a 30–50 ml espresso in just 1–2 minutes – perfect for road trips, camping or the office.

Features

  • 3-in-1 compatibility – works with Nespresso capsules, Dolce Gusto capsules and ground coffee.
  • Fully manual – just add coffee and hot or cold water and press.
  • Compact and light – fits easily in a backpack or travel bag.
  • Easy to clean – removable parts rinse clean in seconds.

Specifications

  • Coffee basket: 10 g ground coffee or one 5–6 g capsule
  • Water tank: 80 ml
  • Output: 30–50 ml espresso
  • Colors: White, Black

Tip: use coarse ground coffee. Fine grounds can clog the filter.

seo.title: Portable Manual Espresso Maker | SIVORA
seo.description: Hand-press espresso maker for capsules or ground coffee. No batteries or electricity, ready in 1–2 minutes. Ideal for travel and camping.

nodes.title: Waterproof Running Belt Phone Pouch
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Run, hike or travel hands-free. This slim waist pouch keeps your phone, keys, cards and cash close to your body, so nothing bounces or falls out while you move.

Features

  • Fits most phones – room for phones up to about 6 inches plus small essentials.
  • Waterproof fabric with a zipper closure.
  • Adjustable strap – wear it on your waist or attach it to your bag.
  • Comfortable backing – soft, quick-drying and sweat-absorbent.
  • Keeps valuables secure – worn close to the body, harder for pickpockets to reach.

Specifications

  • Size: approx. 50 × 10 cm (measured by hand, ±1–3 cm)
  • Colors: Orange, Blue, Green, Black, Pink
  • Included: 1 running belt

seo.title: Waterproof Running Belt & Phone Pouch | SIVORA
seo.description: Slim waterproof running belt that holds your phone, keys and cards. Adjustable strap, zipper closure, 5 colors.

nodes.title: Foldable Squat Rider Machine with LCD
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Build stronger glutes and legs at home. This squat rider guides you through each rep with a supportive seat and handlebar, while three resistance bands let you adjust the challenge. When you're done, fold it away in seconds.

Features

  • 3 resistance bands – about 22 lb each, combine them to match your level.
  • LCD display – tracks time, distance and calories in real time.
  • Guided, comfortable movement – a triangular seat support and ergonomic handlebar help you keep proper form.
  • Works more than legs – multiple grip positions also engage arms, shoulders, back and core.
  • Foldable – stores easily in small spaces.

Specifications

  • Frame: alloy steel
  • Max user weight: 243 lb
  • Recommended user height: 4'11" – 6'11"
  • Dimensions in use: 43.7" D × 19.3" W × 49" H
  • Seat and handlebar: adjustable
  • Color: White

seo.title: Foldable Squat Rider Machine with LCD | SIVORA
seo.description: Foldable squat machine for glutes and quads with 3 resistance bands, LCD tracker and steel frame. Supports up to 243 lb.

nodes.title: Foldable Ab & Core Trainer with LCD
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Work your upper, middle and lower abs plus obliques with a machine built for home. Its 120° curved sliding track targets your core without straining your back or neck, and it folds flat when you're done.

Features

  • 120° curved dual track – a more effective motion than flat vertical tracks.
  • 4 incline levels – the steeper the angle, the harder the workout.
  • 2 resistance bands included for extra challenge.
  • Heavy-duty steel frame supporting up to 440 lb.
  • Comfortable – 0.99" thick knee pads, foam grips and wrist straps.
  • LCD counter – tracks reps, time and calories.
  • Quick setup – assembles in about 5 minutes.

Specifications

  • Material: alloy steel, foam
  • Weight: 19 lb
  • Max user weight: 440 lb
  • In use: 35.5 × 34.5 × 15.7 in
  • Folded: 47.3 × 16.5 × 9.5 in
  • Color: Black

What's included

  • 1 ab machine
  • 1 LCD monitor (requires 1 AA battery, not included)
  • 1 user manual

seo.title: Foldable Ab & Core Trainer with LCD | SIVORA
seo.description: Ab machine with a 120° curved track, 4 incline levels, LCD counter and steel frame rated to 440 lb. Folds flat for storage.

nodes.title: Smart Jump Rope with Counter & LCD
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Make every jump count. This smart jump rope tracks your jumps, time and calories on its built-in display and syncs your workouts with the Renpho Health app so you can follow your progress over time.

Features

  • Accurate counting – a built-in chip with 3 Hall sensors records every jump.
  • 3 modes – free jump, time countdown and count countdown.
  • App tracking – connect to the Renpho Health app to log time, jumps, calories and tangles.
  • Tangle-free cable – 3 m / 9.85 ft PVC-coated steel wire, adjustable without cutting, works on tile or wood floors.
  • Comfortable grip – lightweight, non-slip foam handles with an easy-to-read LCD.

Specifications

  • Rope: PVC-coated steel wire, 3 m / 9.85 ft, adjustable
  • Handles: ABS with EVA foam
  • Color: Black
  • Included: 1 smart jump rope

seo.title: Smart Jump Rope with Counter & App Tracking | SIVORA
seo.description: Smart jump rope with LCD counter, 3 workout modes and app tracking. Adjustable 9.85 ft tangle-free steel cable, comfortable foam handles.

A mat built for real workouts. High-impact foam absorbs shock and protects your joints from hard floors, while non-slip surfaces keep you steady – with or without shoes.

Features

  • 3-layer construction – textured non-skid top, impact-absorbing foam core and gripping base.
  • Stays in place – excellent traction on both sides.
  • Odor-neutralizing – infused with activated charcoal to stay fresh with frequent use.
  • Versatile – great for HIIT, yoga, pilates, stretching and meditation.
  • Easy to carry – includes a carrying strap.

Specifications

  • Size: 26" W × 72" L
  • Color: Teal

nodes.title: 7-Color LED Light Therapy Face Mask
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Bring an LED skincare session home. This lightweight silicone mask combines 7 light colors – including red, blue and yellow – in a comfortable, flexible design you control from the couch.

Features

  • 7 light colors – choose the light mode for your routine.
  • Soft silicone – light, flexible and easy to clean, unlike stiff plastic masks.
  • Eye protection – includes soft eye pads.
  • Secure fit – two adjustable straps.
  • Remote control – switch colors and set a 10, 15 or 20 minute session.

How to use

Use 3–4 times per week for 10–20 minutes on clean, dry skin.

Specifications

  • Material: silicone
  • Color: Black
  • Included: LED mask, remote control, eye pads

seo.title: 7-Color LED Light Therapy Face Mask | SIVORA
seo.description: Flexible silicone LED face mask with 7 light colors, eye pads, remote control and 10/15/20-minute timer. At-home skincare routine.
